content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: The term 'LEASE' shall refer to the agreement between the Landlord and Tenant.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_TERM_OF_LEASE
content_blocks.text: This Lease shall commence on June 16, 2024, and terminate on June 15, 2027.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._RENTAL_PAYMENTS
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, due on the first day of each month.
